description.p: Headroom finds regenerable caches, logs, old snap revisions, Docker leftovers, the Trash and large files on Ubuntu 22.04, shows how much space each one uses and cleans only what you select after showing you exactly what will be removed.

ul.li: Caches of Cursor, VS Code, Electron apps and browsers (never profiles, history or settings)
Developer caches: pip, uv, npm, Go, Cargo, Gradle, Maven, conda, Hugging Face and more
System items through one administrator prompt: APT, journal, rotated logs, snaps, Flatpak
Safe / Caution / Advanced ratings, dry-run mode, preview and a persistent log
